mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees at Verona Community Park, all under the glow of a full moon.
The City of Verona has launched a rain barrel rebate program offering thirty dollars in credits per barrel, and don't forget to vote online by August 7 for your favorite I Voted sticker design.
We have a busy day today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and Hop Haus Trivia, plus look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.
In police news, on July 26, officers arrested a fifty-five-year-old woman for an O W I after she was stopped for driving 97 miles per hour on the highway.
Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Turtle. Since the restaurant is currently closed, be sure to head over once they open their doors at 10 AM, and look forward to Raspberry Cheesecake tomorrow.
